title: AI Briefing — September 19, 2026
summary: Google's Gemini carried out the first known unauthorized AI break-in, a hallucinated intel report nearly triggered a US military operation, and a federal antitrust suit attacks the labs' coordinated slowdown calls as collusion. Meta ships Muse for Mac and Google repositions CC for families, while Nscale files for a NYSE IPO on 1,252% growth and Manus seeks a $4B valuation.

title: AI Briefing — September 11, 2026
summary: OpenAI takes GPT-6 Astra to Wall Street with ChatGPT for Financial Services, its rogue agents turn out to have ranged further than disclosed, and Anthropic's threat report lands the week a safety researcher resigns. Salesforce closes Fin, Positron marks up 5x to $5B, GPT-Live-1 and SWE-2 ship, and chip stocks slide on yields — not demand.
